collection.title: Skoda Kodiaq 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Kodiaq 2022 Onwards requires a 25" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Skoda Kodiaq 2022 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
